# NomiFun v0.6.0

Windows first release for v0.6.0.

## Highlights

- Adds mini-apps: create a normal Nomi conversation that produces a self-contained `miniapp.html`, preview it live, then publish it as a reusable app or replace an existing one explicitly.
- Adds the mini-app library and runner at `/mini-apps`, with published snapshots separated from editable working copies under the app workspace.
- Adds mini-app import and validation for user-authored H5 pages, including concrete validation reports and session-based repair flow.
- Routes provider capabilities through verified modality/protocol mappings, including new or repaired provider adapters and rerank result handling.
- Refines desktop update presentation, WebUI remote access on launch, markdown preview typography, and related UI polish.
